title: Revenue inflation from duplicated orders with new order_ids
issue_description: Total revenue for 2024-01-15 looks unusually high compared to neighboring days -- almost like some orders were counted twice.
ground_truth_root_cause: On 2024-01-15, ~15 completed orders were re-emitted by the upstream order source with brand-new order_id values for what is actually the same underlying transaction (e.g. a checkout-retry / double-submit bug). sql_models/01_stg_orders_cleaned.sql only de-duplicates on order_id (ROW_NUMBER() PARTITION BY order_id), so these rows look like distinct legitimate orders and are not filtered out, inflating that day's revenue in fct_daily_revenue.

ground_truth_location.detail: The dedup window function only catches duplicate rows that share the same order_id; it cannot catch duplicate transactions that were assigned distinct order_id values.
